records.text: Moon-affiliated entities helped bail out Liberty University, including a $3.5 million 1995 grant that purchased part of its debt and a later $400,000 loan.
records.speaker: The Washington Post

appearances.snippet: It tells us also in 1995 ... It gave a $3.5 million grant to the Christian Heritage Foundation ... which later bought a portion of Liberty University's debt ... Last year, News World Communications ... lent $400,000 to Liberty at a 6% interest according to the promissory note.

verification.notes: The amounts, payment forms, and Liberty University connection match the cited 1997 Washington Post investigation.
